# Ridgetown Heating & Cooling

> Ridgetown Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Ridgetown, Chatham-Kent, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 674-0171  |  Email: contact@ridgetownheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ridgetownheatingcooling.ca
